items.stem: Which situation is the correct fit for the LEED Operations and Maintenance rating system?

options.text: A building under new ground-up construction
options.rationale: New construction is addressed by BD+C, not O+M.

options.text: An existing, occupied building improving its ongoing operations
options.rationale: Correct: O+M targets existing, occupied buildings and their operational performance.

options.text: An undeveloped greenfield site with no building
options.rationale: With no building to operate, O+M does not apply.

options.text: A product seeking a material ingredient label
options.rationale: That is a product certification, not building O+M.

items.explanation: Correct: O+M targets existing, occupied buildings and their operational performance.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: What is the primary purpose of a performance period in LEED O+M?

options.rationale: O+M concerns operations, not construction scheduling.

options.text: To demonstrate actual building performance over a defined span of operation
options.rationale: Correct: the performance period captures real operational data to demonstrate ongoing performance.
Aesthetics are not the purpose of a performance period.
Documentation is still required; the period provides the data.

items.explanation: Correct: the performance period captures real operational data to demonstrate ongoing performance.

items.stem: Which TWO operational measures support sustainable building operations under O+M?

options.text: Implementing a green-cleaning policy with preferred products
options.rationale: Correct: green-cleaning policies support sustainable operations and IEQ.

options.text: Ongoing energy and water performance benchmarking
options.rationale: Correct: continuous benchmarking is central to O+M performance.

options.text: Disabling ventilation to save energy regardless of air quality
options.rationale: Compromising air quality harms IEQ and is not sustainable operation.

options.text: Discarding all monitoring data each month

items.explanation: Correct: green-cleaning policies support sustainable operations and IEQ.
